Logic Analysis: app.py
Initializes the Flask app, database, and other configurations. Imports routes and models.
models.py
Defines the database models: User, Resume, and Template. Includes methods for user authentication (hashing passwords) and resume data management.
forms.py
Defines the ResumeForm using WTForms. Includes fields for work experience, education, skills, and other information. Contains validation logic.
routes.py
Defines the routes for handling user authentication, resume creation/editing, template selection, resume preview, and PDF generation. Uses Flask's routing and view functions.
utils/pdf_generator.py
Contains the PDFGenerator class with the generate_pdf method. Uses ReportLab or WeasyPrint to generate PDF files from resume data and templates.
templates/base.html
Base template for all HTML pages. Includes common elements like header, footer, and navigation.
templates/resume_form.html
Template for rendering the resume form. Uses Jinja2 to display form fields and error messages.
templates/resume_templates.html
Template for displaying available resume templates. Allows users to select a template.
templates/resume_preview.html
Template for displaying a preview of the resume. Uses Jinja2 to render resume data based on the selected template.
static/css/style.css
CSS file for styling the application.
static/js/script.js
JavaScript file for handling client-side interactions and form validation.
Full API spec: No API spec needed, as there is no inter-service communication.
Shared Knowledge: The `utils/pdf_generator.py` module contains the core logic for converting resume data into a PDF format. The `templates` directory holds Jinja2 templates for rendering HTML pages and resume previews. The `static` directory contains CSS and JavaScript files for front-end styling and interactions.
